title: [Main] Reopening and re-finishing production order reposts backward-flushed routing capacityupdate
summary: Fixed an issue where reopening and re-finishing a production order would incorrectly repost backward-flushed routing capacity entries.
key_points: Production order status management now correctly handles routing capacity postings when orders are reopened
Backward-flushed routing capacities are properly recalculated during re-finishing
Bug fix prevents duplicate or incorrect capacity ledger entries in manufacturing workflows
Changes to codeunit 5407 'Prod. Order Status Management'
Test coverage added to verify the fix
